text:
elaine_cs: Heads-up: Lantern Labs renewal (50 seats) wants to close this week. Procurement insists on PO + vendor code but buyer says credit card is fine if they cover fees. They also asked for a brief security addendum. Need owner for signatures and payment path — cc @mike_acct @jordan_legal

mike_acct: I’ll take procurement. Pinged their Melissa for PO fields and expected GL code. Should have vendor code in a few hours.

jordan_legal: Legal has no pricing redlines. Term request: shorten 12 -> 9 months (pro rata). Acceptable if auto-renew stays. For security addendum, ask whether SOC2 attestation is acceptable or if they’ll provide their draft.

sophia_fin: If CC chosen, require PO with note "paid by credit card" for our records. If PO/net30 and EU billing, we need invoice-splitting approval. CC fastest for activation.

tom_success: Scheduling 20-min signoff call tomorrow 11:00am PT to confirm payment route and signature owners. If CC -> I’ll trigger DocuSign; if PO -> Mike will submit PO and I’ll queue onboarding.

esign-bot: Draft envelope created: LanternRenewal_2987654321. Waiting for final SOW attachment. Doc link: https://docusign.example/lantern/lnr2987654321

mike_acct: Procurement replied: vendor code VC-7777 for US, VC-EU-7777 for EU. Will generate a PO once we send amended SOW and billing entity.

elaine_cs: Quick plan: 1) Upload amended SOW with 9-month dates; 2) Confirm buyer preference on call; 3) If CC -> DocuSign same day; if PO -> expect 48-72h processing. Aim: signatures by Fri EOD. Drop blockers here.
